_comment: Resize grips on a deep block sit at its flank: a lone 80-horse Cavalry column (drill mode, no opponent) stands centred at (800, 400) facing south, a narrow, very deep block. It is clicked to select it, and its two resize grips appear just past its east and west flanks -- 180 wu either side of its centre (its half-width of 4 file gaps at 40 wu, plus a horse's 10 wu body radius and the 10 wu handle gap) -- rather than out at the radius of the circle enclosing the whole block (about 520 wu, deep in open ground). The east grip is then dragged further east, widening the column into a broader, shallower block. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
